items.title: Outcomes of a nurse-led rapid chest pain pathway in a South Western Sydney emergency department
items.abstract: A retrospective cohort study evaluating time-to-disposition and safety outcomes following introduction of a nurse-led rapid assessment pathway for low-risk chest pain presentations at Campbelltown Hospital.

items.title: Prevalence of frailty among older adults admitted under general medicine at a Western Sydney hospital
items.abstract: A cross-sectional study of frailty prevalence and its association with length of stay among patients aged 65 and over admitted to general medicine.

items.title: Feasibility of a group-based pulmonary rehabilitation program delivered via telehealth for COPD patients in South Western Sydney
items.abstract: This pilot study assessed feasibility, adherence and patient-reported outcomes for a telehealth-delivered pulmonary rehabilitation program for patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

items.title: Antimicrobial stewardship audit of empirical sepsis prescribing in a South Western Sydney emergency department
items.abstract: A clinical audit of guideline concordance for empirical antibiotic selection in suspected sepsis presentations, with recommendations for prescribing pathway redesign.
